# hyperfluid_alert_channel (Resource)

A notification channel alerts are delivered through. A signal routed to no channel reaches every enabled one, so a new channel is live at once. Needs the organization's `alerting_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperfluid_alert_channel" "ops_mail" {
  name       = "ops-mail"
  kind       = "email"
  recipients = ["ops@acme.io", "sre@acme.io"]
}

# `url` is write-only (Terraform >= 1.11): the platform only returns it masked.
# To rotate it, change `url` together with `url_wo_version`.
variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "hyperfluid_alert_channel" "ops_slack" {
  name           = "ops-slack"
  kind           = "slack_webhook"
  url            = var.slack_webhook_url
  url_wo_version = "1"
}

# A Microsoft Teams channel takes the URL of a Teams Workflows webhook
# ("Post to a channel when a webhook request is received").
variable "teams_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "hyperfluid_alert_channel" "ops_teams" {
  name           = "ops-teams"
  kind           = "teams_webhook"
  url            = var.teams_webhook_url
  url_wo_version = "1"
}

# A Matrix or Tchap room, posted to by a hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot. `room`
# takes a room id (`!…`) or an alias (`#…:server`); an alias is resolved by the
# platform, kept as configured here, and the resolved id is in `matrix.room_id`.
resource "hyperfluid_alert_channel" "ops_tchap" {
  name = "ops-tchap"
  kind = "matrix"
  matrix = {
    bot_id = hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot.tchap.id
    room   = "#ops-alerts:agent.dinum.tchap.gouv.fr"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) `email`, `slack_webhook`, `discord_webhook`, `teams_webhook` (a Microsoft Teams Workflows webhook) or `matrix` (a Matrix or Tchap room, posted to by a `hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot`).
- `name` (String) Channel name, unique in the organization.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether alerts are delivered; a disabled channel keeps its routing.
- `matrix` (Attributes) The bot and room of a `matrix` channel; required for that kind and refused for the others. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--matrix))
- `recipients` (Set of String) Email addresses; required for `email`, refused for the other kinds.
- `url` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Webhook URL, required on create for a webhook kind and refused for `email` and `matrix`; write-only (Terraform 1.11 or later). Left out on update, the stored URL is kept. A Teams URL must be on `*.logic.azure.com` or `*.environment.api.powerplatform.com`.
- `url_wo_version` (String) Any value; change it together with `url` to rotate the webhook URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `url_masked` (String) The webhook URL, truncated by the platform.

<a id="nestedatt--matrix"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matrix`

Required:

- `bot_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot` that posts the alerts.
- `room` (String) Room id (`!abc:server`) or alias (`#ops:server`). The platform resolves an alias through the bot and stores the id; the configured value is kept here, so an alias does not show a diff against the resolved id.

Read-Only:

- `room_id` (String) The room id the alerts are posted to, resolved from `room`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Alert channel import id is the channel id (uuid).
# url and url_wo_version are write-only and cannot be recovered on import.
terraform import hyperfluid_alert_channel.ops_slack 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
